fusions.name: Drumming Hooves
fusions.desc: Kicks out twice in quick succession, 2 blows spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Unflagging Rush
fusions.desc: Charges up to 7 tiles to an enemy, which deals 14 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It is slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Bottomless Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs dry, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
